title: Coordinate polarization
statement: Let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$ and let $i$ be a coordinate. Define a new Boolean function by assigning, at each input $x$, the larger of $f(x^{i,+})$ and $f(x^{i,-})$ when $x_i=1$, and the smaller when $x_i=-1$, where $x^{i,+}$ and $x^{i,-}$ are obtained from $x$ by setting coordinate $i$ to $1$ and $-1$, respectively.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
